options.title: ChatScribe Settings
options.subtitle: Customize ChatScribe's appearance and export behavior.
options.headings.groupHint: The ChatGPT conversation title is the document title. Each Q&A group gets one Question 1, Question 2, etc. entry in the outline; original headings stay bold in the answer text.
options.separator.groupHint: Each question and its answers form a group. Two horizontal rules separate groups.
options.downloads.promptToSave: Ask where to save on each export
options.downloads.downloadImages: Bundle images with export as a ZIP
options.downloads.imagesHint: When enabled, images are saved into an images/ folder and linked by relative paths. Disable to omit image attachments entirely.
options.downloads.includeGeneratedImages: Include images generated in ChatGPT answers
options.downloads.generatedImagesHint: Applies when image bundling is enabled. Turn off to omit images generated in ChatGPT answers.
options.downloads.filenameFormatHint: Choose a preset. The preview updates immediately.
options.downloads.filenameTemplateHint: Use {title}, {date}, {time}, or {datetime}. The file extension is added automatically.
options.downloads.subfolderHint: Relative to the browser's Downloads folder, for example ChatScribe/Study. Leave blank to use Downloads.
options.downloads.subfolderError: Enter a relative path under Downloads without a leading slash, dot path segments, or reserved filename characters.
options.copyMenu.keepExpandedHint: Keep “Copy latest answer” and “Choose messages…” visible whenever ChatScribe is open.
options.timestamp.include: Include export date/time at the top of the file
options.appearance.panelModeHint: Unlike a popup, the sidebar stays open when it loses focus. Switch tabs or apps, then return to Chrome to view ChatScribe and export progress.
options.language.label: Language
options.language.hint: Choose the language for the ChatScribe interface.
options.github.disconnected: Save exports directly to a GitHub repository.
options.githubOverlay.title: Connect GitHub
options.githubOverlay.instruction: A GitHub tab has opened. Enter this code there and approve access to ChatScribe.
github.error.expired: GitHub connection expired or revoked. Please reconnect.
github.error.codeExpired: GitHub login code expired. Please try again.
github.error.unknown: GitHub login failed for an unknown reason.
options.appearance.themeHint: The system setting follows your browser or operating system theme.
